# Aurum Invoice Studio

> Invoice, receipt and quotation app for Nigerian businesses. Pay once, no monthly fees. Works on a phone, even without data. Clients receive a private, wax-sealed link and the owner sees when it is opened.

Aurum is an invoicing app, not accounting software: it does not run payroll, track stock or file taxes.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/): what Aurum is and pricing
- [About and contact](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/about/): how buying works, refunds, WhatsApp contact
- [Reviews](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/reviews/): customer reviews
- [Invoice app for Nigerian businesses](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/invoice-app-nigeria/): Make invoices, receipts and quotations on your phone, with your logo and bank details. Your clients open them as an experience. Pay once, no monthly fees.
- [Receipt maker for Nigerian businesses](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/receipt-maker-nigeria/): Make professional payment receipts on your phone in one tap, with your logo and a Paid stamp. Turn any paid invoice into a receipt. Pay once.
- [Quotation maker for Nigerian businesses](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/quotation-maker-nigeria/): Make professional price quotations on your phone with a valid-until date and deposit. When accepted, turn it into an invoice in one tap. Pay once.
- [Send invoices on WhatsApp with a private link](https://auruminvoice.com.ng/whatsapp-invoice/): Stop typing prices in WhatsApp chats. Send a private, wax-sealed invoice link, see when it is opened and remind clients in one tap. Pay once.
